package fixture

// The fixed shape: the same inner `go test`, with the child's environment
// built by goenv.Clean so the caller's GOFLAGS cannot reshape the output the
// parser reads. A tool that needs a variable of its own appends it after
// Clean, where the last value wins.

import (
	"context"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"

	"github.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/internal/goenv"
)

func runUnits(ctx context.Context, wt string, names []string) map[string]bool {
	failed := map[string]bool{}
	args := []string{"test", "-count=1", "-v", "-run", "^(" + strings.Join(names, "|") + ")$", "./pkg/"}
	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "go", args...)
	cmd.Dir = wt
	cmd.Env = goenv.Clean(os.Environ())
	out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		return failed
	}
	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(out), "\n") {
		if strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(line), "--- FAIL: ") {
			failed[line] = true
		}
	}
	return failed
}

func buildTool(dir, out string) error {
	cmd := exec.Command("go", "build", "-o", out, dir)
	cmd.Env = append(goenv.Clean(os.Environ()), "CGO_ENABLED=0")
	return cmd.Run()
}
